ns2:course.label: Advanced Screenwriting
ns2:course.description: Builds on the knowledge and skills acquired in Screenwriting. Use writing exercises to further expand on proper formatting, creating dynamic and 3-dimensional characters and creating interesting plot structures. Readings from published scripts will be used to give examples of current script practices. Same as MACS 472. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MACS 372.
